sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement
sources.supports: §5 requires the statement 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' to be clearly and prominently stated on the Site. §5 also bars implying Amazon endorses or sponsors the Site. §2 requires Associates to comply with the Agreement. §7 disclaims warranties on Special Links and link formats.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies (Participation Requirements; Commission Income Statement)
sources.supports: Participation Requirements §1: Site must have original content; third-party material needs significant commentary. §2(a): Special Links must use the Associates ID assigned. §2(b): tag must be in every link URL; links must be accessed directly from the Site; prices and availability may be shown only if Amazon serves the link or via Creators API / PA API; no misleading claims about products. §3(c)–(e): Site owner is responsible for content, legal compliance and cookie/data disclosure. §4: no offline use of Special Links, including in printed material. §6(a)–(b): do not alter Program Content; do not create tagged links for a site that is not your Site. Commission Income Statement §2(g): links that are not properly formatted are disqualified.

sources.title: Associates Program Standard Commission Income schedule
sources.supports: Commission rates by category. NOT VERIFIED: the page redirected to an Amazon sign-in screen when fetched, so no rate was read. No rate is published on this site.

sources.title: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
sources.supports: Disclose when there is a financial relationship with a brand. Place the disclosure where it is hard to miss, with the endorsement itself. Disclosures that appear only on an About page or at the end of content are likely to be missed. Use simple terms such as 'ad' or 'sponsored'. Points to the FTC Endorsement Guides.

sources.title: Qualify your outbound links to Google (rel="sponsored")
sources.supports: rel="sponsored" marks advertisements or paid placements (paid links). Multiple rel values may be combined.

sources.title: Creating a GitHub Pages site
sources.supports: A branch-and-folder publishing source (for example the /docs folder on main) must have its entry file (index.html) at the top level of that folder. Changes can take up to 10 minutes to publish. Repositories on GitHub Free must be public.

sources.title: Understanding ASIN numbers: Your guide to Amazon's product identification system
sources.supports: An ASIN is a unique 10-character alphanumeric code assigned to each product in the Amazon store. Formats typically start with 'B0'. The ASIN appears after '/dp/' in a product URL.
